8430-the-mountebank.title: The Mountebank
8430-the-mountebank.creator: William J. Locke
8430-the-mountebank.description: A book by William J. Locke. Is there a _lusus naturæ_ of any nationality but English, who rising from Private to Brigadier-General, could write six hundred and seventy-three sprawling foolscap pages purporting to contain the story of his life from eighteen-eighty something to June nineteen hundred and nineteen and deliberately omit, as if it were neither here nor there, its four and a half years' glorious and astounding episode?

arxiv-2205-01507.title: The effects of Galactic model uncertainties on LISA observations of double neutron stars 2022 The effects of Galactic model uncertainties on LISA observations of double neutron stars – References
arxiv-2205-01507.creator: Anatole Storck, Ross P. Church
arxiv-2205-01507.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Anatole Storck, Ross P. Church. Observations of binaries containing pairs of neutron stars using the upcoming space-based gravitational wave observatory, LISA, have the potential to improve our understanding of neutron star physics and binary evolution. In this work we assess the effect of changing the model of the Milky Way’s kinematics and star formation history on predictions of the population of double neutron stars that will be detected and resolved by LISA.

arxiv-2309-08840.title: Oscillator strengths and excited-state couplings for double excitations in time-dependent density functional theory
arxiv-2309-08840.creator: Davood B. Dar, Neepa T. Maitra
arxiv-2309-08840.description: Abstract Although useful to extract excitation energies of states of double-excitation character in time-dependent density functional theory that are missing in the adiabatic approximation, the frequency-dependent kernel derived earlier [J. Chem. Phys. 120 , 5932 (2004)] was not designed to yield oscillator strengths.

arxiv-2401-16299.title: Enhancing Molecular Property Prediction with Auxiliary Learning and Task-Specific Adaptation
arxiv-2401-16299.creator: Vishal Dey, Xia Ning
arxiv-2401-16299.description: Abstract Pretrained Graph Neural Networks have been widely adopted for various molecular property prediction tasks. Despite their ability to encode structural and relational features of molecules, traditional fine-tuning of such pretrained GNNs on the target task can lead to poor generalization.

arxiv-2408-12108.title: Multiple non-hermitian phase transitions on quantum torus surface
arxiv-2408-12108.creator: José A. S. Lourenço 1 and Ygor Pará 2 and J. Furtado 3,4
arxiv-2408-12108.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the arising of non-hermitian phase transitions on quantum torus surfaces. We consider a single fermion whose dynamics is governed by the Dirac equation confined to move on a quantum torus surface. The effects of the geometry are take into account by using the tetrad formalism and the spin connection.

arxiv-2501-14115.title: Passivity-Based Robust Shape Control of a Cable-Driven Solar Sail Boom for the CABLESSail Concept Journal: Acta Astronautica
arxiv-2501-14115.creator: Soojeong Lee, Ryan J. Caverly
arxiv-2501-14115.description: Abstract Solar sails provide a means of propulsion using solar radiation pressure, which offers the possibility of exciting new spacecraft capabilities. However, solar sails have attitude control challenges because of the significant disturbance torques that they encounter due to imperfections in the sail and its supporting structure, as well as limited actuation capabilities.

arxiv-2502-07167.title: Quantifying Quantumness in (A)dS spacetimes with Unruh-DeWitt Detector
arxiv-2502-07167.creator: Li-Juan Li, Xue-Ke Song, Liu Ye, Dong Wang
arxiv-2502-07167.description: Abstract Probing quantumness in curved spacetime is regarded as one of fundamental and important topics in the framework of relativistic quantum information. In this work, we focus on the theoretical feasibility of probing quantum properties in de Sitter (dS) and Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes via detectors.

arxiv-2504-16981.title: Phases of Dark Matter from Inverse Decays
arxiv-2504-16981.creator: Ronny Frumkin 1,2, Yonit Hochberg 1,3, Eric Kuflik 1,3, Hitoshi Murayama 4,5,6
arxiv-2504-16981.description: Abstract Inverse decays are an interesting avenue for producing dark matter in the early universe. We study in detail various phases of dark matter parameter space where inverse decays control its abundance, expanding on our work of INDY dark matter and going beyond. The role of initial conditions and the impact of departure from kinetic equilibrium are investigated as well.

arxiv-2506-16356.title: Comparison between External and Internal Single Stage Planetary gearbox actuators for legged robots
arxiv-2506-16356.creator: Aman Singh 1 , Deepak Kapa 2 , Prasham Chedda 3 , Shishir N.Y. Kolathaya 1
arxiv-2506-16356.description: Abstract Legged robots, such as quadrupeds and humanoids, require high-performance actuators for efficient locomotion. Quasi-Direct-Drive (QDD) actuators with single-stage planetary gearboxes offer low inertia, high efficiency, and transparency. Among planetary gearbox architectures, Internal (ISSPG) and External Single-Stage Planetary Gearbox (ESSPG) are the two predominant designs.

arxiv-2602-09827.title: Scaling laws for the cutoff wavenumber of the short-wavelength ion-temperature-gradient mode in a Z-pinch
arxiv-2602-09827.creator: O. Gupta \aff 1,2 \corresp, M. Barnes \aff 1,3, F. I. Parra \aff 4, L. Podavini \aff 5, A. Zocco \aff 5, T. Adkins \aff 4 and P. G. Ivanov \aff 6
arxiv-2602-09827.description: Abstract We use a heuristic fluid model to predict the dependence of the cutoff wave number for the short-wavelength ion temperature gradient (SWITG) mode on ion density gradient, ion temperature gradient (ITG) and ion-electron temperature ratio. In particular, we predict that the cutoff wave number increases linearly with increasing ITG for sufficiently large values of the ITG.

pmc-11428706.title: Effects of Resveratrol-Loaded Cyclodextrin on the Quality Characteristics of Ram Spermatozoa Following Cryopreservation
pmc-11428706.creator: Ahmet Eser, Selin Yağcıoğlu, Ramazan Arıcı, Kamber Demir, Kemal Ak
pmc-11428706.description: Simple SummaryThis study evaluated the impact of resveratrol-loaded cyclodextrin (RLC) on the quality of ram sperm after thawing. Our hypothesis was that resveratrol-loaded cyclodextrin, which enhances the antioxidant activity of resveratrol (RES), would improve the outcomes of freezing ram semen.

pmc-11480825.title: Multiplexed detection of respiratory pathogens using a portable device combining a CREM strategy†
pmc-11480825.creator: Xijuan Gu, Anli Pan, Lingwei Wu, Jing Zhang, Zixun Xu, Tao Wen, Miaomiao Wang, Xiuying Shi, Li Wu, Yuling Qin
pmc-11480825.description: Rapid and precise detection of respiratory pathogens is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment of respiratory infections. In this study, the multiplex and visual detection of respiratory pathogens is facilitated by specifically designed engineered CRISPR RNA (en-crRNA) to activate the trans-cleavage activity of Cas12a, along with a homemade portable device.

pmc-12594608.title: Neuroprotective Effects of Ginsenoside Rg3 in Depressed Mice via Inhibition of the C1q Complement Pathway
pmc-12594608.creator: Daofeng Yang, Xinran Xu, Xuerui Zhuo, Hui Cai, HaoTian Wang, Hao Liu, Yiming Sun
pmc-12594608.description: AimsTo explore the neuroprotective effect of Ginsenoside Rg3 in a mouse model of depression induced by chronic restraint, and to elaborate whether it exerts a protective effect by inhibiting the upregulation of complement factor C1q and related microglial cell‐mediated synaptic injury.MethodsThe mouse chronic restraint model of depression was prepared from male C57BL/6 mice.

pmc-12621443.title: Sagittal biplanar ‘L’-shaped tibial osteotomy associated with osteochondral allograft for symptomatic varus knee and low patella
pmc-12621443.creator: Eliseo Javier Firman, Eduardo Manuel Río, Adrián Nicolás Sirio
pmc-12621443.description: IntroductionThe “L”-shaped tibial osteotomy is a relatively recent surgical technique aimed at correcting the mechanical axis without altering patellar height or posterior tibial slope (common complications associated with conventional medial opening wedge osteotomies).Case presentationWe report the case of a young patient with symptomatic genu varum, osteochondral lesion in the medial femoral condyle, and low patellar height.

pmc-13295575.title: Bacterial Persister Cells as Evolutionary Catalysts of Antibiotic Resistance: Mechanisms, Clinical Implications, and Therapeutic Strategies
pmc-13295575.creator: Tae-Jong Kim
pmc-13295575.description: Antibiotic resistance is a growing global health threat. However, its evolution cannot be fully understood without considering antibiotic tolerance and persistence. Persister cells are phenotypic variants that survive lethal antibiotic exposure without heritable resistance, primarily through growth arrest, metabolic slowdown, and stress-adaptive states.

pmc-13397668.title: Lifting more than weights: practical insights into strength training for a child with special needs—a case report
pmc-13397668.creator: Volodymyr Maksym
pmc-13397668.description: BackgroundResistance training remains underused in the rehabilitation of children with neurodevelopmental disorders, despite growing evidence of its multidimensional benefits beyond muscular strength. This case describes how an adapted resistance exercise program appeared to support functional, behavioral, and emotional changes in a child with developmental delay secondary to perinatal hypoxic brain injury.
